newsitem.title: USA: Sawtek three mln share offering underway.
newsitem.headline: Sawtek three mln share offering underway.

text.p: Sawtek Inc, an electronics and communications equipment maker, said an offering of three million shares of its common stock is underway at a price of $33.50 a share.

Sawtek issued 300,000 new shares and selling shareholders sold 2,700,000 shares, which included 2,500,000 from the Sawtek Employee Stock Ownership Plan and trust. The proceeds of the sale from the ESOP will be used to permit investment diversification of employees' retirement accounts for liquidity needs. The ESOP retains a 35 percent stake in the company.
The company's net proceeds will be used for capital expenditures and general corporate purposes, including working capital.
